nuke.command.description: How the Nuke tasks start Nuke: a name on PATH or the path of nuke.cmd (bin/ in the IED repository).

nuke.packages.fetchMinutes.description: How often IED fetches a trusted workspace's Nuke packages (nuke package status --fetch), in minutes; also when the workspace opens. A develop clone that falls behind its remote then turns read-only by itself until it is pulled. 0: never (only Nuke commands you run notice).
